raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# What does this PR do?

Avoid unnecessary gradient computation and memory allocations in NPU fused MoE kernels when expert weights are frozen, such as during LoRA training.

Honor `ctx.needs_input_grad` in stacked and list-backed grouped matmul to save only tensors needed for backward and compute only the required gradients. Preserve input gradients so upstream trainable layers continue to receive gradients.

## Before submitting

- [x] Did you read the [contributor guideline](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
- [ ] Did you write any new necessary tests?

nodes.body:
Before merging, I suggest addressing the following points. Since this PR targets backward computation and memory overhead, it would be helpful to provide before/after measurements for:

Fused MoE backward latency.

Peak allocated memory.

End-to-end training step time or tokens/s.

The number of grouped matmul calls, especially confirming that weight-gradient GMM calls are eliminated for frozen experts.

Please include the NPU model, CANN/torch_npu versions, Transformers version, and representative training configurations.
About the scope of this pr, consider about this unconditional case

grad_outputs_contiguous is constructed unconditionally before checking which experts actually require gradients. This can introduce unnecessary copies for non-contiguous gradients belonging to inactive backward branches. Could we restrict this operation to the union of input_indices and weight_indices?

detail.body:
# What does this PR do?

Avoid unnecessary gradient computation and memory allocations in NPU fused MoE kernels when expert weights are frozen, such as during LoRA training.

Honor `ctx.needs_input_grad` in stacked and list-backed grouped matmul to save only tensors needed for backward and compute only the required gradients. Preserve input gradients so upstream trainable layers continue to receive gradients.

## Before submitting

- [x] Did you read the [contributor guideline](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
- [ ] Did you write any new necessary tests?
